no_multiplicity_correction: Four baselines are compared per position with no correction for multiple comparisons.

recompute_check.note: Largest absolute difference between rz_target_share / rz_carry_share recomputed with kneels and spikes excluded and buildRedZone's (the committed red-zone.json). A check, not a tuning input.

excluded_player_weeks.note: Reason priority: bye, no_target_or_carry, null_share, then not_seen (a reason only under the primary reading; the sensitivity reading scores those players with 0). no_history counts players with a week-W red-zone target or carry and no stats row before W, position unknown.
